# CSKB-Population
Codes for the EMNLP2021 paper: [Benchmarking Commonsense Knowledge Base Population with an Effective Evaluation Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07679)

We have an expert-annotated and adversarially constructed evaluation set [CKBP v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.10392).

For data preprocessing and the codes released upon EMNLP 2021, checkout the branch `emnlp2021` (https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CSKB-Population/tree/emnlp2021).

## Data

CKBP v1: [training data](https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CSKB-Population/tree/emnlp2021), [evaluation set](https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CSKB-Population/blob/main/data/evaluation_set.csv).

CKBP v2: [training data (updated)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/14imdF7yeKPf0_pNyj6Fbv_EhlvH3OXDx/view?usp=sharing), [evaluation data](https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CSKB-Population/blob/main/ckbp_v2/ckbp2.0.csv)

## Environment

We tested our codes on `python 3.8.5`. Here are some packages their corresponding versions.

```
networkx                 2.5
numpy                    1.19.2
pandas                   1.2.2
scikit-learn             0.24.1
scipy                    1.6.3
sklearn                  0.0
spacy                    3.2.0
stanfordnlp              0.2.0
torch                    1.7.1
torch-geometric          1.7.2
torch-scatter            2.0.7
torch-sparse             0.6.9
torchsummary             1.5.1
torchtext                0.8.1
tqdm                     4.56.0
transformers             3.4.0
```

## Dataset Preprocess

See the branch [`emnlp2021`](https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CSKB-Population/tree/emnlp2021)

## Model Training

### Download the data

```
kaggle datasets download -d tianqingfang/ckbp-emnlp2021
```

Or download at https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/tianqingfang/ckbp-emnlp2021.

Put the `train.csv` under `data/ckbp_csv/emnlp2021/`. The `dev.csv` and `test.csv` are automatically constructed dev and test sets, sampled from ASER and CSKBs (CSKB ground truth triples are labeled 1, negative sampled examples are labeled 0.)

The annotated evaluation set is at `data/evaluation_set.csv`. Please use this data set to test.

### Train w/ KG-BERT (BERT-base)

KG-BERT baseline is provided here.

```
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python models/train_kgbert_baseline.py \
    --ptlm bert-base-uncased \
    --lr 1e-5 \
    --epochs 1 \
    --output_dir results \
    --train_csv_path data/ckbp_csv/emnlp2021/train.csv \
    --relation_as_special_token \
    --save_best_model \
    --seed 100 --batch_size 64 --test_batch_size 128 --save_best_model --experiment_name ""
```

### Access the whole graph data

Check out `Model Training` section on the branch [`emnlp2021`](https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CSKB-Population/tree/emnlp2021#model-training).

## Results

(Note that the evaluation metric is a bit different from that in the paper. In the paper we use a grouped AUC where AUC scores within different groups are calculated and averaged. Here we report the overall AUC across all relations.)

|Model|All|Ori Test Set|CSKB head|ASER edge|
|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|
|KG-BERT (BERT-base) | 62.5 | 74.2 | 51.9 | 54.7|
|KG-BERT (RoBERTa-large) | 70.9 | 78.0 | 63.4 | 64.6|

## Reproduce DISCOS using current version of ASER\_norm

Checkout the [`DISCOS-reproduce`](https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CSKB-Population/tree/emnlp2021/DISCOS-reproduce) folder under the branch [`emnlp2021`](https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CSKB-Population/tree/emnlp2021).

## 诊断结论

已完成对该仓库的诊断,未继续深入训练是因为在数据获取环节遇到了阻塞(详见下方)。过程总结:

**环境判断**:README 明确给出 `python 3.8.5` + `torch 1.7.1` + `transformers 3.4.0` 等版本,Docker 镜像(`python:3.8-slim`)可正常拉取,本机也有 GPU(`nvidia-smi` 正常),环境侧没有障碍。

**数据判断(关键阻塞点)**:
- README 复现 KG-BERT baseline 结果表所需的训练数据 `train.csv`,要求通过 `kaggle datasets download -d tianqingfang/ckbp-emnlp2021` 获取。
- 实测该 Kaggle 数据集页面返回 **HTTP 404**(已被删除/失效),`curl -sI` 验证两次均为 404。
- README 中还提到一个 Google Drive 链接,但那是标注为 "CKBP v2 (updated)" 的训练数据,与论文实验表格(基于 emnlp2021 分支训练数据)所用的版本并不确认一致,存在 `version_uncertain` 风险,不能作为可靠替代直接用于复现论文报告的具体数字。
- 仓库内置的 `data/evaluation_set.csv`(31732 行)是评测集,是可用的,但没有训练集就无法真正训练模型得到 README 表格里的 AUC 数字。

## 诊断结论

已完成对该仓库的诊断,未继续深入训练是因为在数据获取环节遇到了阻塞(详见下方)。过程总结:

**环境判断**:README 明确给出 `python 3.8.5` + `torch 1.7.1` + `transformers 3.4.0` 等版本,Docker 镜像(`python:3.8-slim`)可正常拉取,本机也有 GPU(`nvidia-smi` 正常),环境侧没有障碍。

**数据判断(关键阻塞点)**:
- README 复现 KG-BERT baseline 结果表所需的训练数据 `train.csv`,要求通过 `kaggle datasets download -d tianqingfang/ckbp-emnlp2021` 获取。
- 实测该 Kaggle 数据集页面返回 **HTTP 404**(已被删除/失效),`curl -sI` 验证两次均为 404。
- README 中还提到一个 Google Drive 链接,但那是标注为 "CKBP v2 (updated)" 的训练数据,与论文实验表格(基于 emnlp2021 分支训练数据)所用的版本并不确认一致,存在 `version_uncertain` 风险,不能作为可靠替代直接用于复现论文报告的具体数字。
- 仓库内置的 `data/evaluation_set.csv`(31732 行)是评测集,是可用的,但没有训练集就无法真正训练模型得到 README 表格里的 AUC 数字。
